== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a Facebook photograph posted 29 January 2026. The Facebook photo viewer names Michael Girard. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 120 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Apache Junction, Az). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/thegirard.

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030161042 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Michael Girard Facebook portrait.jpg]].
